# Bottom flange: diameter 43.2, Z 0 to 4.8 (r=21.6, h=4.8)
bottom = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(43.2 / 2).extrude(4.8)

# Core: diameter 18.8, Z 4.8 to 24.2 (r=9.4, h=19.4) -> translate Z 4.8
core = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(18.8 / 2).extrude(24.2 - 4.8).translate((0, 0, 4.8))

# Top flange: diameter 43.2, Z 24.2 to 29 (r=21.6, h=4.8) -> translate Z 24.2
top = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(43.2 / 2).extrude(29 - 24.2).translate((0, 0, 24.2))

# Union flanges and core
main = bottom.union(core).union(top)

# Centre bore: diameter 9.2 through everything along Z
# Height 31 from Z -1 to 30 to ensure clean through cut
bore = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(9.2 / 2).extrude(31).translate((0, 0, -1))

# Wire slot: X -22.6 to 22.6 (45.2 long), Y -2 to 2 (4 wide), Z 0 to 4.8 (4.8 high)
# Created as rectangle extruded from XY plane, centered at origin
slot = cq.Workplane("XY").rect(45.2, 4).extrude(4.8)

# Cut bore and slot
result = main.cut(bore).cut(slot)
